children.text: pyarelala1914
children.translated_text: Pyarelal, 1914

children.text: श्रीगणेशाय नम: ।।
children.translated_text: Obeisance to Śrī <s>Gaṇeśa</s>.

children.text: अथ रागबिनोद ।।
children.translated_text: Now begins the <s>Rāgavinoda</s> (Delight of Melody).

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: जै जै जै जगदम्ब भवानी ।।
करमे खप्पर शूल लिये हैं रथकी ध्वजा
children.translated_text: In her hands she holds the skull-bowl and trident; the banner of her chariot

children.text: फहरानी ।। १ ।। जै जै ० ।। केहरिपर सवार
children.translated_text: is fluttering. //1// Victory! Mounted upon a lion,

children.text: माता ह्वै करत शत्रु की हानी ।। २ ।।
children.translated_text: the Mother destroys the enemies. //2//

children.text: जै जै ० ।। तुमहीं हौ सब काम संवारनि
children.translated_text: Victory! You alone accomplish all tasks;
you alone are the auspicious voice. //3// Victory!

children.text: जन प्यारेके शोकहरो सब आपन किंकर
children.translated_text: O remover of the grief of your servant <s>Pyāre</s>, knowing all as your own

children.text: जानी ।। ४ ।। जै जै जैजगदम्बभवानी ।।
children.translated_text: servants. //4// Victory, victory, victory to <s>Jagadambā Bhavānī</s>!

children.text: दो० सिद्ध करनि सब कामको, और सुभग वरदान।
children.translated_text: Dohā: She who accomplishes all desires and bestows auspicious boons —

children.text: तुम बिन माता देतको, मम मूरख को ज्ञान ।।
children.translated_text: without you, Mother, who will give knowledge to this fool?

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: गजबदन को कर गान ।।
children.translated_text: Sing the praise of the elephant-faced one (<s>Gaṇeśa</s>)!

children.text: एक दन्त सवारी मूसा, जपत सकल
children.translated_text: The one-tusked one rides a mouse; the whole

children.text: जहान ।। १ ।। अब गजबदन ० ।। देव नर
children.translated_text: world chants [his name]. //1// Sing of <s>Gaṇeśa</s>! Gods, humans,

children.text: गन्धर्ब किन्नर, धरत प्रथमै ध्यान ।। २ ।।
children.translated_text: <s>gandharvas</s>, <s>kinnaras</s> — they meditate on him first. //2//

children.text: अब गजबदन० ।। एक ऊपर सुन्न रथ जो,
children.translated_text: Sing of <s>Gaṇeśa</s>! The one above <s>Śūnya</s> (the Void) and the chariot —

children.text: तासु पुत्र बखान ।। ३ ।। अब गजबदन० ।।
children.translated_text: praise that one's son. //3// Sing of <s>Gaṇeśa</s>!

children.text: कहत प्यारे सिद्धिदायक, नामकरों स-
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says: the bestower of <s>siddhi</s> — his name I sing

children.text: गान ।। ४ ।। अब गजबदन को कर गान ।।
children.translated_text: with devotion. //4// Sing the praise of the elephant-faced one!

children.text: दो ० लम्बोदर दुखके हरण, करण सफल मन काज ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: O pot-bellied remover of sorrows, who fulfills all desires of the mind —

children.text: बारबार मस्तक नऊं, कृपा करो, अब आज ।।
children.translated_text: again and again I bow my head; show mercy now, today.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: जे गरुचरण रेणु शिर धारत ।।
children.translated_text: Those who place the dust of the <s>Guru</s>'s feet upon their heads —

children.text: भूरि भागि के भाजन होयँगे सब विष-
children.translated_text: they shall become vessels of great fortune, warding off all

children.text: यन को टारत ।। १ ।। जे गुरुचरण ० ।।
children.translated_text: worldly [temptations]. //1// Those who place the <s>Guru</s>'s feet [on their heads] —

children.text: यमके त्रास सकल बिधि नाशत जे गुरु
children.translated_text: the fear of <s>Yama</s> is completely destroyed for those who utter

children.text: मन्त्र उचारत ।। २ ।। जे गुरुचरण ०।।
children.translated_text: the <s>Guru</s>'s <s>mantra</s>. //2// Those who place the <s>Guru</s>'s feet —

children.text: तमके गृह को दीपक गुरु सिखवन सो
children.translated_text: the <s>Guru</s>'s teaching is the lamp in the house of darkness;

children.text: पद मूढ़ बिसारत ।। ३ ।। जे गुरुचरण ० ।।
children.translated_text: the fool forgets that state. //3// Those who place the <s>Guru</s>'s feet —

children.text: जन प्यारे गुरुपद पंकज उर कलि
children.translated_text: Servant <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] the <s>Guru</s>'s lotus-feet in the heart

children.text: साउज हनि डारत ।। ४ ।। जे गुरुचरण
children.translated_text: destroy the sin of the <s>Kali</s> age. //4// Those who place the dust of the <s>Guru</s>'s

children.text: रेणु शिर धारत ।।
children.translated_text: feet upon their heads.

children.text: दो ० बिनु गुरु मुक्ति न पावहीं, सुर नर असुर समूह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Without the <s>Guru</s>, neither gods, humans, nor hosts of <s>asuras</s> attain liberation.

children.text: गुरु के सिखवनसुमिरिकै, तरे खलनके जूह ।।
children.translated_text: Remembering the <s>Guru</s>'s teaching, even herds of the wicked have crossed over.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: औधेशासुत रघुबीरहो ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Raghuvīra</s>, son of the lord of <s>Avadha</s> (Ayodhyā)!

children.text: तन बस्त्र शोभित पीतहैं कर कमल
children.translated_text: His body is adorned with yellow garments; in his lotus-hands
are bow and arrow. //1// Son of <s>Avadha</s>'s lord! Taking

children.text: सखा संग फिरैं नगर कबहों सरजुके तीर
children.translated_text: his companion along, he wanders through the city; sometimes by the banks of the <s>Sarayū</s>

children.text: हो ।। २ ।। औधेशा० ।। भरत लछिमन
children.translated_text: river. //2// Son of <s>Avadha</s>'s lord! Together with <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>,

children.text: रिपुदमन युत बन्धु सब रणधीरहो ।। ३ ।।
children.translated_text: and <s>Ripudamana</s> (<s>Śatrughna</s>) — all brothers, valiant in battle. //3//

children.text: औधेशा ० ।। मात निरखि मुख चन्द्रको
children.translated_text: Son of <s>Avadha</s>'s lord! Seeing his moon-like face, [says] the mother,

children.text: प्यारे हटी तनपीर हो ।। ४ ।। औधेशा
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] the pain of the body has departed. //4// Son of <s>Avadha</s>'s lord,

children.text: सुत रघुबीर हो ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Raghuvīra</s>!

children.text: दो० अवध नृपतिके सुभग सुत, लखन राम सुखकन्द।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The beautiful sons of the king of <s>Avadha</s> — <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s>, <s>Rāma</s>, the root of joy,

children.text: भरत शत्तुहन चारि ये, सबको देत अनद ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Bharata</s>, <s>Śatrughna</s> — these four give delight to all.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: सुकुमार जसुमति लालरे ।।
children.translated_text: O tender darling of <s>Yaśodā</s>!

children.text: अधर बांके नयन सुन्दर गले मोतिन
children.translated_text: Curved lips, beautiful eyes, a necklace of pearls

children.text: रागविनोद । ५
children.translated_text: Rāgavinoda, [page] 5
around his neck. //1// O tender darling! With arched brow,

children.text: ञ्च ल मुख कमल जिमि घूंघुरवाले बालरे
children.translated_text: a lotus-face with curly hair,

children.text: ।। २ ।। सुकुमार ० ।। करकमलपद नम्र
children.translated_text: little boy. //2// O tender darling! With lotus-hands, a body bowed [in play],

children.text: तन अति चलत तिरछी चालरे ।। ३ ।।
children.translated_text: walking with a swaying gait. //3//

children.text: सुकुमार ० । । बृषभ कन्धर श्रवणकुण्डल
children.translated_text: O tender darling! With bull-like shoulders, ear-ornaments —

children.text: प्यारे होत कि निहालरे ।। ४ ।। सुकुमार जसु-
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says: can one not be enraptured? //4// O tender darling of

children.text: मतिलालरे ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Yaśodā</s>!

children.text: दो ० कृष्ण चन्द्र आनन्द बन, गोपिन प्राण अधार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Kṛṣṇacandra</s> is a forest of bliss, the life-support of the <s>gopīs</s>.

children.text: प्यारेको निज भीक्तदै, करौ हृदय पैसार ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Pyāre</s>, grant your devotion and make a place in [my] heart.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: दिनप्रति ध्याओ श्री रघुनन्दन ।।
children.translated_text: Every day, meditate upon Śrī <s>Raghunandana</s>!

children.text: गाओगीत मनोहर हरिके नाम जपो
children.translated_text: Sing the enchanting songs of <s>Hari</s>; chant the name of

children.text: नागर नँदनन्दन ।। १ ।। दिनप्रति ० ।। जा-
children.translated_text: the urbane <s>Nandanandana</s> (son of <s>Nanda</s>). //1// Every day! While

children.text: गत राम सोवत महँ रामै मार्ग चलत महँ
children.translated_text: waking, <s>Rāma</s>; while sleeping, <s>Rāma</s>; while walking on the path,

children.text: ६ रागिबनोद ।
children.translated_text: [page] 6, Rāgavinoda.

children.text: करु पदबन्दन ।। २ ।। दिनप्रति० ।। दै
children.translated_text: bow at [his] feet. //2// Every day! After bathing,

children.text: अस्नान ध्यान आराति करु खौर दउ शुभ
children.translated_text: perform meditation and worship; offer shaving and auspicious

children.text: चन्दन ।। ३ ।। दिनप्रति० ।। प्यारे नाम
children.translated_text: sandalwood. //3// Every day! <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] chant the name

children.text: जपो कमलापति जो है असुरनिकन्दन
children.translated_text: of the lord of <s>Kamalā</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>), who is the destroyer of <s>asuras</s>.

children.text: ।। ४ ।। दिनप्रति ध्याओ श्रीरघुनन्दन ।।
children.translated_text: //4// Every day, meditate upon Śrī <s>Raghunandana</s>!

children.text: दो०यह संसार असार में, आपन है नहिं कोइ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: In this unsubstantial world, no one is truly one's own.

children.text: अस अपने मनसमुझिकै, करौ जो कीना होइ ।।
children.translated_text: Understanding this in your mind, do what needs to be done.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: या जग में नहिं आपन कोई ।।
children.translated_text: In this world, no one is truly one's own.

children.text: सुतबित नारि भवन और भूषण निज
children.translated_text: Son, wealth, wife, house, and ornaments — even one's own

children.text: तन हो नहिं होई ।। १ ।। या जग में० ।।
children.translated_text: body is not [truly one's own]. //1// In this world —

children.text: परिप्रपञ्च प्रभु को बिसरायो गरलखात
children.translated_text: Forgetting the Lord in this world of illusion, [one] loses

children.text: अमृतफल खोई ।। २ ।। या जग में० ।।
children.translated_text: the nectar-fruit by consuming poison. //2// In this world —

children.text: जा तन पर घमण्ड बहु लावत बारिबुन्द
children.translated_text: That body upon which you lavish so much pride, it is

children.text: सम सोई ।। ३ ।। या जग में० ।। जन
children.translated_text: like a drop of water. //3// In this world — Servant

children.text: प्यारे अबहीं मन चेतौ नाम जपो घट घट
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] awaken your mind now! Chant the Name, for He dwells in every heart.

children.text: में जोई ।।४।। या जगमें नहिं आपन कोई।।
children.translated_text: //4// In this world, no one is truly one's own.

children.text: दो० सुत बित नारी भवन में, है भूलो सब कोइ ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Everyone has become deluded in sons, wealth, wife, and home.

children.text: महिशिर जेहि अरि तासु प्रभु, मूढ़ बिसारेउ सोइ ।।
children.translated_text: That Lord who holds the earth upon [His] head — the fool has forgotten Him.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: मोसम कौन कुटिल अघखानी ।।
children.translated_text: Who is as wicked and sin-consuming as I?

children.text: शम्भु श्यामकर नाम न लीन्हेउ विष-
children.translated_text: I have not taken the names of <s>Śambhu</s> or <s>Śyāma</s>, [being] intoxicated by

children.text: यनके रससानी ।। १ ।। मोसम० ।। या मुख
children.translated_text: the pleasures of the senses. //1// Like me — From this mouth

children.text: सों शुभ बात न कीन्हेउ जेहि तेहि कहेउँ
children.translated_text: I have not spoken auspicious words; to each and every one I have spoken

children.text: कटुक बहुबानी ।। २ ।। मोसम० ।। या कर
children.translated_text: many harsh words. //2// Like me — With these hands

children.text: सों कछु दान न दीन्हेउ लेबो बहुबिधि
children.translated_text: I have given no charity; but I know many ways

children.text: जानी ।। ३ ।। मोसम० ।। कहै जन प्यारे
children.translated_text: of taking. //3// Like me — Servant <s>Pyāre</s> says:

children.text: रधुनाथ उबारे आपन शिशु मोहिंजानी
children.translated_text: <s>Raghunātha</s> has saved me, knowing me as His own child.

children.text: ।। ४ ।। मोसम कौन कुटिल अघखानी ।।
children.translated_text: //4// Who is as wicked and sin-consuming as I?

children.text: दो० या बिधि को मैं पातकी, सुनियो दीनदयाल ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: I am such a sinner — hear me, O Compassionate to the lowly!

children.text: पतित उबारन नाम है, मम अघ हरो कृपाल ।।
children.translated_text: Your name is 'Uplifter of the fallen' — remove my sins, O Merciful One!

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: नाम बिन कौन भयो भव पार ।।
children.translated_text: Without the Name, who has crossed the ocean of existence?

children.text: बेद पुराण भनत यश थाकत तेउ न
children.translated_text: The Vedas and Purāṇas grow weary praising [Him], yet they do not

children.text: पावत पार । बालमीकि नारद सनका-
children.translated_text: reach the farther shore. <s>Vālmīki</s>, <s>Nārada</s>, <s>Sanakādi</s> —

children.text: दिक तिनहुँ के प्राण अधार ।। १ ।।
children.translated_text: He is the life-support of even them. //1//

children.text: नाम बिन० ।। ध्रुव प्रहलाद और पारा-
children.translated_text: Without the Name — <s>Dhruva</s>, <s>Prahlāda</s>, and <s>Parāśara</s>,

children.text: शर अरु मुनिबृन्द अपार । हरिहित
children.translated_text: and countless hosts of sages. For <s>Hari</s>'s sake,

children.text: सुखसम्पति सब त्यागेउ दरशदीन क-
children.translated_text: they renounced all happiness and wealth — merciful and compassionate

children.text: रतार ।। २ ।। नाम बिन० ।। सूरदास
children.translated_text: to the poor. //2// Without the Name — <s>Sūradāsa</s>,

children.text: शरभंग कपिलमुनि अरु मनु अवधभु-
children.translated_text: <s>Śarabhaṅga</s>, sage <s>Kapila</s>, and <s>Manu</s> the lord of

children.text: वार । नामहेत तृण यों सब त्यागेउ राज
children.translated_text: <s>Avadha</s>. For the sake of the Name, they renounced kingdom,

children.text: पाट संसार ।। ३ ।। नाम बिन० ।। प्यारे
children.translated_text: throne, and the world like grass. //3// Without the Name — <s>Pyāre</s> [says:]

children.text: रागविनोद । ९
children.translated_text: Rāgavinoda, [page] 9

children.text: रसना नाम ररति नहिं कस होइ हौ भव
children.translated_text: the tongue does not delight in the Name — how then shall I cross the ocean of existence?

children.text: पार । दशरथ सुत सों याही अरज़ है
children.translated_text: This alone is my plea to the son of <s>Daśaratha</s> —

children.text: बांह पकरि निरवार ।। ४ ।। नाम बिन
children.translated_text: seize my arm and ferry me across. //4// Without the Name,

children.text: कौन भयो भवपार ।।
children.translated_text: who has crossed the ocean of existence?

children.text: दो० राम नाम नौका सुभग, भवसागर की धार ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: <s>Rāma</s>'s Name is the beautiful boat in the current of the ocean of existence.

children.text: जिन नौका दृढ़ नहिं गहेउ, सो कस होइहैं पार ।।
children.translated_text: He who has not firmly grasped that boat — how shall he reach the other shore?

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: को न मिटेउ हरिजनहि सताई ।।
children.translated_text: Who has not been destroyed for persecuting the devotees of <s>Hari</s>?

children.text: दुर्बासा अम्बरीष सतायो रामचक्र
children.translated_text: <s>Durvāsā</s> persecuted <s>Ambarīṣa</s> — <s>Rāma</s>'s discus

children.text: तिहुँपुरभरमाई ।। १ ।।कोन०।। तुलसी को
children.translated_text: terrified all three worlds. //1// Who has not — <s>Tulasī</s> was

children.text: दिल्लीपति ढाहेउ हरि पायक तेहि भवन ढ-
children.translated_text: attacked by the lord of Delhi; <s>Hari</s>'s messenger destroyed that one's

children.text: हाई ।। २ ।। को न० ।।हरिणाकुश प्रहलाद
children.translated_text: house. //2// Who has not — <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s> [persecuted] <s>Prahlāda</s>;

children.text: खम्भहनि प्रकटभये हरिउद्र नसाई ।।३ ।।
children.translated_text: from the pillar <s>Hari</s> manifested in [His] man-lion [form] and destroyed [him]. //3//

children.text: को न० ।। जन प्यारे बसुदेव नन्द
children.translated_text: Who has not — Servant <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] from <s>Vasudeva</s> to <s>Nanda</s>,

children.text: सों आरत नाद सहो नहिं जाई ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: the cry of distress cannot be borne. //4//

children.text: को न मिटेउ हरिजनहिं सताई ।।
children.translated_text: Who has not been destroyed for persecuting the devotees of <s>Hari</s>?

children.text: दो० आरत नाद करेउ गज, ग्राह ग्रसेउ जल मध्य ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The elephant made a cry of distress when the crocodile seized him in the water.

children.text: पौन जाहि भख तेहि अरि, चढ़ि ग्राहै कियो बध्य ।
children.translated_text: The wind [came] to devour that enemy; mounting [the crocodile], He made it powerless.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: अब मन रामचरण अनुरागो ।।
children.translated_text: Now, O mind, be devoted to the feet of <s>Rāma</s>!

children.text: काम क्रोध और लोभ दुष्टमति दम्भ
children.translated_text: Desire, anger, greed, wicked mind, pride,

children.text: कपट सब त्यागो ।। १ ।। अब मन ० ।। हरि
children.translated_text: deceit — abandon all. //1// O mind —

children.text: भक्तन सतसंग ढंग शुभ प्रभु बिमुखन
children.translated_text: Keep the good company of <s>Hari</s>'s devotees; flee from those

children.text: सों भागो ।। २ ।। अबमन ० ।। हरि यश
children.translated_text: who are averse to the Lord. //2// O mind —

children.text: सुधा सरितसम पावन ता यशमें चित
children.translated_text: The fame of <s>Hari</s> is pure as a river of nectar;

children.text: लागो ।। ३ ।। अबमन ० । । प्यारे जो पुत्र
children.translated_text: fix your mind upon that fame. //3// O mind — <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] he who becomes

children.text: भवन को नायक होई है तबहिं सभा-
children.translated_text: the master of sons and home becomes auspicious only when [devoted to <s>Rāma</s>].

children.text: गो ।। ४ ।। अबमन रामचरण अनरागो ।।
children.translated_text: //4// Now, O mind, be devoted to the feet of <s>Rāma</s>!

children.text: दो० हे मन मूरख चावरे, कर रघुवर सों नेह ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: O foolish, simple mind, make love with <s>Raghuvara</s>.

children.text: बार धाम धन द्रव्य सब, और वारिये देह ।।
children.translated_text: Sacrifice wife, home, wealth, riches, and even the body.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: अब मन कृष्णसों कर नेह ।
children.translated_text: Now, O mind, make love with <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>!

children.text: वार सब धन धाम धरनी और वारौ
children.translated_text: Sacrifice all wealth, home, land, and even sacrifice the

children.text: देह ।। १ ।। अब मन० ।। संग तेरे कोई
children.translated_text: body. //1// O mind — No one will go

children.text: न जैहै बित्त बाहन गेह ।। २ ।।अब मन०।।
children.translated_text: with you — neither wealth nor vehicle nor home. //2// O mind —

children.text: भ्रमित निशिदिन धन कुटुम्ब में बृथा सब
children.translated_text: Wandering night and day among wealth and family — all other

children.text: परस्नेह ।। ३ ।। अब मन० ।। प्यारे दृग
children.translated_text: affections are in vain. //3// O mind — <s>Pyāre</s> [says:] let tears of love

children.text: सों प्रेम जल ढुरु जैसे बरषत मेह ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: flow from your eyes like the pouring rain. //4//

children.text: अब मन कृष्णसों करनेह ।।
children.translated_text: Now, O mind, make love with <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>!

children.text: दो० नेह करो मन कृष्ण सों, घट घट बासी जौन ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Love <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, O mind — He who dwells in every heart.

children.text: नाम लेत पातक टरै, कस बिसरायो तौन ।।
children.translated_text: By taking His name, sins depart — why then have you forgotten Him?

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: सुनोरे मन कस बिसरे नँदलाल ।।
children.translated_text: Listen, O mind — why have you forgotten <s>Nandalāla</s> (<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>)?

children.text: रतिकरपति तेहि अरितिया संयुत
children.translated_text: The lord of <s>Rati</s> (<s>Kāma</s>) and his adversary's wife together

children.text: करत जासु पद ख्याल ।। १ ।। सुनोरे ० ।।
children.translated_text: contemplate His feet. //1// Listen —

children.text: तमअरितनया बढ़ीं चरणहित कञ्च
children.translated_text: The daughter of darkness's enemy grew great for the sake of [His] feet; by touching His lotus

children.text: पाँव छुह भईहैं निहाल ।। २ ।। सुनोरे ० ।।
children.translated_text: feet she became blessed. //2// Listen —

children.text: सृष्टिरचन अरु धनद धर्म शशि नाम ज-
children.translated_text: The creator of the world, the lord of wealth, <s>Dharma</s>, the moon — [even] <s>Yama</s> the lord of death

children.text: पत यमकाल ।। ३ ।। सुनोरे ० ।। प्यारे
children.translated_text: chants [His] name. //3// Listen — <s>Pyāre</s> [says:]

children.text: रसना जपु हरिके पद निशिदिन श्री
children.translated_text: let the tongue chant the name of <s>Hari</s>, night and day, Śrī

children.text: गोपाल ।। ४ ।। सुनो रे मन कस बिसरे
children.translated_text: <s>Gopāla</s>. //4// Listen, O mind — why have you forgotten

children.text: नँदलाल ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Nandalāla</s>?

children.text: दो ० मीम नून ते वाव सुन, पूछों तोसों बात ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Hear, O [letter] mīm, nūn, and vāv — I ask you a question.

children.text: रेअल्लिफ़ अरु मीमको, छोड़तहौ कहि भांत ।।
children.translated_text: How can you abandon the [letter] re, alif, and mīm? [i.e., Rām]

children.text: (भजन प्रभाती)
children.translated_text: (Morning hymn / <s>prabhātī</s>)

children.text: जागो श्री रघुनन्दनप्यारे ।।
children.translated_text: Awaken, O beloved Śrī <s>Raghunandana</s>!

children.text: कोक शोक, पङ्कज कर संपुट मिटि
children.translated_text: The <s>cakravāka</s> bird's grief [has ended]; the lotus cups its petals [open],

children.text: निज दलनपसारे ।। १ ।। जागो श्री ० ।।
children.translated_text: spreading out its own petals. //1// Awaken, Śrī —

children.text: शशिकी किरण मलिन तारे छिपि रबि
children.translated_text: The moon's rays have dimmed, the stars have hidden; the sun

children.text: निज तेज प्रचारे ।। २ ।। जागो श्री० ।। धेनु
children.translated_text: spreads its own radiance. //2// Awaken, Śrī — All the cows

children.text: सकल बच्छन पय प्यावैं पंछिन शब्द
children.translated_text: give milk to their calves; the birds call out

children.text: पुकारे० ।। ३ ।। जागोश्री ।। प्यारे कहत
children.translated_text: their sounds. //3// Awaken, Śrī — <s>Pyāre</s> says:

children.text: दासन मुददीजे रघुबर प्राणअधारे ।।४।।
children.translated_text: Give joy to your servants, O <s>Raghuvara</s>, support of our lives! //4//

children.text: जागो श्रीरघुनन्दनप्यारे ।।
children.translated_text: Awaken, O beloved Śrī <s>Raghunandana</s>!

children.text: दो० पूरुबसों रबि उदय भो, सुनो नन्द फ़रज़न्द ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: The sun has risen in the east — hear, O child of <s>Nanda</s>!

children.text: सचराचर जड़ जीवनर, सबको देहू अनन्द ।।
children.translated_text: Give bliss to all — moving and still, inert and living.

children.text: (भजन प्रभाती)
children.translated_text: (Morning hymn / <s>prabhātī</s>)

children.text: जागो जागो रघुनन्दनप्यारे भोरभयो ।।
children.translated_text: Awaken, awaken, beloved <s>Raghunandana</s> — dawn has come!

children.text: उडुगण मिटि नभ खाली होइ गयो
children.translated_text: The host of stars has faded, the sky has become empty,

children.text: सब तम घोर गयो ।। १ ।। जागोजागो० ।।
children.translated_text: all deep darkness has gone. //1// Awaken —

children.text: शशिकर तेज छीन रबि उगिहै बछवन
children.translated_text: The moon's radiance has diminished; the sun will rise; the calves

children.text: छीर पियो ।। २ ।। जागोजागो० ।। मधुप
children.translated_text: have drunk their milk. //2// Awaken —

children.text: आय कलियनपर गुञ्चत पङ्कज शोक
children.translated_text: Bees come buzzing upon the buds; the lotus's

children.text: गयो ।। ३ ।। जागोजागो० ।। दास तुम्हारो
children.translated_text: grief has departed. //3// Awaken —

children.text: नाम सब टेरत प्यारे तो आश कियो ।।४।।
children.translated_text: Your servants call your name — O <s>Pyāre</s>, they have set their hope upon you. //4//

children.text: जागोजागो रघुनन्दनप्यारे भोरभयो ।।
children.translated_text: Awaken, awaken, beloved <s>Raghunandana</s> — dawn has come!

children.text: दो० जागो श्री रघुनन्दन, दासन को मुददेहु ।
children.translated_text: Dohā: Awaken, Śrī <s>Raghunandana</s>! Give joy to your servants.

children.text: दृष्टि विमल सों हरिकै, प्यारेकी सुधि लेहु ।।
children.translated_text: With the pure glance of <s>Hari</s>, take heed of <s>Pyāre</s>.

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (Hymn)

children.text: ऐसो नाम बिनोद बढ़ावन ।।
children.translated_text: Such a Name — it increases delight (<s>vinoda</s>)!

children.text: दुखहिं हरन सब सुख उपजावन
children.translated_text: It removes sorrow, produces all happiness,

children.text: भूषण भवन भँडार बढ़ावन ।। १ ।।
children.translated_text: increases ornaments, homes, and treasuries. //1//

children.text: ऐसो० ।। कलिको पाप संचित नहिं राखत
children.translated_text: Such [a Name]! It does not allow the accumulated sins of the <s>Kali</s> age to remain;

children.text: दुष्टदलन तमधार बहावन ।। २ ।।ऐसो० ।।
children.translated_text: it crushes the wicked and washes away the stream of darkness. //2// Such [a Name]!

children.text: हरि बिकार यमलोक छुङावन भवसागर
children.translated_text: It removes the impurities of <s>Hari</s> and frees one from the realm of <s>Yama</s>; it ferries one across

children.text: सों पारकरावन ।। ३ ।। ऐसो० ।। कुमति
children.translated_text: the ocean of existence. //3// Such [a Name]! The wicked mind —

children.text: हानि उर सुमतिसुहावन प्यारे के सब
children.translated_text: Loss in the heart, <s>Pyāre</s>'s all beautiful good sense,

children.text: शोकनशावन ।। ४ ।। ऐसो नाम बिनोद
children.translated_text: destroyer of sorrow. || 4 || Such a name that increases delight.

children.text: बढ़ावन ।।
दो० करत मङ्गलाकार है, रामचन्द्र को नाम ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: The name of <s>Rāmacandra</s> brings auspiciousness.

children.text: सौदा कैसो सुभगहै, कौड़ी लगे न दाम ।।
children.translated_text: What a wonderful bargain it is — it costs not a single cowrie. ||

children.text: (भजन)
children.translated_text: (<s>Bhajan</s>)

children.text: शंकर शिरपर अहिमौर धरे डमरू कर
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> wears a serpent-crown upon his head, and with a <s>ḍamarū</s> (drum) in hand

children.text: डिमिकि बजावत हैं ।।
children.translated_text: he plays its ḍimiki beat. ||

children.text: अँग भस्मभास तिरशूल लिये कैलास
children.translated_text: His body shines with ash, holding a trident, upon the peak of <s>Kailāsa</s>

children.text: शिखर नित छावत हैं ।। १ ।। शंकर ० ।।
children.translated_text: he ever dwells. || 1 || <s>Śaṅkara</s> refrain ||

children.text: संग जोगिनि जूह बैताल बृन्द अरु
children.translated_text: With him are hosts of <s>yoginīs</s>, troops of <s>vetālas</s> (spirits), and

children.text: भूतन के गण धावत हैं ।। २ ।। शंकर ० ।।
children.translated_text: hordes of <s>bhūtas</s> (ghosts) running about. || 2 || <s>Śaṅkara</s> refrain ||

children.text: भृकुटीबिशाल अरु नयनलाल अरु बाहन
children.translated_text: His brows are large and his eyes are red, and his bull-mount

children.text: बैल सजावतहैं ।। ३ ।। शंकर ० ।। केहरि
children.translated_text: he adorns. || 3 || <s>Śaṅkara</s> refrain || With a lion's

children.text: कराल अरु चन्द्रभाल प्यारे पार्वती सहि
children.translated_text: fierce form and the moon on his brow, <s>Pyāre</s> says, together with <s>Pārvatī</s>

children.text: भावित ।। ४ ।। शंकर शिरपर अहिमौर
children.translated_text: he is adored. || 4 || <s>Śaṅkara</s> wears a serpent-crown upon his head,

children.text: धरे डमरूकर डिमिकि बजावतहैं ।।
children.translated_text: with a <s>ḍamarū</s> in hand he plays its ḍimiki beat. ||

children.text: दो० सरितापति ताकी सुता, ताप्रिय बाहन जौन ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: She whose father is the lord of rivers, whose beloved mount is the bull,

children.text: ताभख जेहि शिरपर बसै, सुधि लेहै मम तौन ।।
children.translated_text: whose food-offering dwells upon his head — may that one take heed of me. ||

children.text: (ठुमरी)
children.translated_text: (<s>Ṭhumarī</s>)

children.text: अब सुतको बरजो नँदरानी ।।
children.translated_text: Now restrain your son, O Queen <s>Nanda</s>! ||

children.text: डगर चलत मोसों रार करत नित
children.translated_text: Walking on the path he quarrels with me every day,

children.text: तनको मै नहिं मानी ।। १ ।। अब सुत० ।।
children.translated_text: I have not accepted his mischief at all. || 1 || Now restrain your son... ||

children.text: शिरकी मटुक मोरी चटपट पटकत भो
children.translated_text: He snatches the pot from my head and dashes it instantly — he has become

children.text: कबको बड़ दानी ।। २ ।। अब सुत० ।।
children.translated_text: such a great giver for so long! || 2 || Now restrain your son... ||

children.text: चञ्चल चपल सुत अचल छैल छल बीच
children.translated_text: Restless and nimble, your son — unwavering yet mischievous — in the middle of

children.text: डगर हठठानी ।। ३ ।। अब सुत० ।। कहत
children.translated_text: the path he is stubbornly standing. || 3 || Now restrain your son... || He says

children.text: करत सोई मातु न पड़त बल प्यारे यों
children.translated_text: and does as he pleases, the mother cannot prevail; <s>Pyāre</s> says, thus

children.text: कहत तुमहौ ममरानी ।। ४ ।। अब सुत को
children.translated_text: he calls even you 'my queen'. || 4 || Now restrain your son,

children.text: बरजो नँदरानी ।।
children.translated_text: O Queen <s>Nanda</s>! ||

children.text: दो० ऐसो ढीठ किशोर तब, सुनो मातु नँदरानि ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Such a bold youth he was, listen O mother, Queen <s>Nanda</s>,

children.text: डगर चलन मोहिं देतनहिं, मांगत गोरस दानि ।।
children.translated_text: he would not let me walk on the path, demanding gifts of milk. ||

children.text: (ठुमरी रागदेश)
children.translated_text: (<s>Ṭhumarī</s>, <s>Rāga Deś</s>)

children.text: जबबसिहोहृदयरघुबीर,सभागीहोबतबै।।
children.translated_text: When <s>Raghubīra</s> (Rāma) dwells in the heart, then indeed one becomes fortunate. ||

children.text: आपन शिशु मोहिं जानि रमापति
children.translated_text: Knowing me as his own child, <s>Ramāpati</s> (Lord of Lakṣmī)

children.text: गहिहौ बांह जबै ।। १ ।। सभागी होब०।।
children.translated_text: will hold my arm then. || 1 || One becomes fortunate... ||

children.text: ज्ञान अखण्ड नेम ब्रत पूजन दाया धर्म
children.translated_text: When undivided knowledge, vows, worship, compassion, and <s>dharma</s> (righteousness)

children.text: फबै ।। २ ।। सभागी होब० ।। तौ पद
children.translated_text: shine forth, || 2 || one becomes fortunate... || then in those lotus

children.text: कञ्ज माहिं मन लागै परिहिर आश सबै
children.translated_text: feet the mind will be absorbed, abandoning all other hopes.

children.text: ।। ३ ।। सभागी होब० ।। प्यारेके ईश राम
children.translated_text: || 3 || One becomes fortunate... || <s>Pyāre</s>'s Lord <s>Rāma</s>,

children.text: दुखमोचन मिलिहो मोहिं कबै ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: the remover of sorrows — when will you meet me? || 4 ||

children.text: सभागी होब तबै जब बसिहौ हृदय
children.translated_text: One becomes fortunate only then, when <s>Raghubīra</s> dwells

children.text: रघुबीर ।।
children.translated_text: in the heart. ||

children.text: दो० जब बसिहौ रघुनन्दन, धरे चक्रको हाथ ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: When <s>Raghunandana</s> (Rāma) dwells within, holding the discus in his hand,

children.text: पीत बस्त्तयुत शोभित, होबै तबै सनाथ ।।
children.translated_text: clad in yellow garments and resplendent — only then does one become blessed. ||

children.text: (ठुमरी पर्च)
children.translated_text: (<s>Ṭhumarī Parc</s>)

children.text: यमुनतटबासी कन्हैयाहो ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Kanhaiyā</s> (Kṛṣṇa), dweller on the banks of the <s>Yamunā</s>! ||

children.text: मोरमुकुट कमरी के उढ़ैया ।। मधुबन
children.translated_text: Wearer of the peacock-crown and the blanket, || in <s>Madhubana</s>

children.text: धेनु चरैयाहो ।। १ ।। यमुन० ।। कटि में
children.translated_text: he grazes the cows! || 1 || O dweller on the <s>Yamunā</s>... || At the waist

children.text: पीतबस्त्त बनमाला ।। गोपिन संग नचैया
children.translated_text: he wears yellow cloth and a forest garland, || with the <s>gopīs</s> (cowherd women) he dances

children.text: हो ।। २ ।। यमुन० ।। सरसिजनयन मो-
children.translated_text: merrily! || 2 || O dweller on the <s>Yamunā</s>... || Lotus-eyed, enchanting

children.text: हनीमूरति ।। मुरली अधर धरैयाहो ।। ३ ।।
children.translated_text: form, || he holds the flute to his lips! || 3 ||

children.text: यमुन० ।। उदधिसुतापति जन दुखमो-
children.translated_text: O dweller on the <s>Yamunā</s>... || Husband of the daughter of the ocean (<s>Lakṣmī</s>), remover of the sorrows

children.text: चन ।। प्यारे हृदय बसैयाहो ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: of devotees, || <s>Pyāre</s> says, dwell in my heart! || 4 ||

children.text: यमुन तटबासी कन्हैया हो ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Kanhaiyā</s>, dweller on the banks of the <s>Yamunā</s>! ||

children.text: दो० हे नँद नन्द नंद अनान्द नँद, हे मुकुन्द ब्रजचन्द ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: O <s>Nanda</s>'s bliss, O joy of <s>Nanda</s>, O <s>Mukunda</s>, moon of <s>Vraja</s>,

children.text: हे दामोदर दुख दलन, दया दुष्टहित मन्द।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Dāmodara</s>, crusher of sorrows, compassionate yet stern toward the wicked. ||

children.text: (दादरा)
children.translated_text: (<s>Dādrā</s>)

children.text: हमरे मन रघुबर आय बसो ।।
children.translated_text: O best of <s>Raghu</s>'s line, come and dwell in my heart! ||

children.text: टेक।।दूरि बिकार करो तनको शुचि अरु
children.translated_text: Refrain. || Remove the impurities of this body, purify it, and

children.text: सब पातक मोर नसो।। १ ।।हमरे मन० ।।
children.translated_text: destroy all my sins. || 1 || Come dwell in my heart... ||

children.text: मम उरमें तुवपद इमि सो हैं पङ्कजमें जिमि
children.translated_text: May your feet abide in my heart, just as a bee

children.text: मधुप लसो ।। २ ।। हमरे मन० ।। जा पद
children.translated_text: shines within a lotus. || 2 || Come dwell in my heart... || Those feet whose

children.text: रज पत्नीऋषि तरिगई सो पद मम चित
children.translated_text: dust liberated the sage's wife (<s>Ahalyā</s>) — may those feet sink deep

children.text: माहिं धसो ।। ३ ।। हमरे मन० ।। ह्वै है
children.translated_text: into my heart. || 3 || Come dwell in my heart... || <s>Pyāre</s>'s fortune

children.text: भाग तबै प्यारे की जब सिय सहि हिय
children.translated_text: will be made only when <s>Siyā</s> (<s>Sītā</s>) and her Lord

children.text: आय बसो ।। ४ ।। हमरे मन रघुबर
children.translated_text: come and dwell in the heart. || 4 || O best of <s>Raghu</s>'s line,

children.text: आय बसो ।।
children.translated_text: come and dwell in my heart. ||

children.text: दो० जा पदरज योगी यती,चाहत हैं दिन रैन ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Those feet whose dust yogis and ascetics desire day and night —

children.text: सो पद प्यारे उर बसो, करो हमेशा शैन ।।
children.translated_text: may those feet dwell in <s>Pyāre</s>'s heart and bring peace forever. ||

children.text: २० रागबिनोद।
children.translated_text: 20 <s>Rāgabinoda</s> (Delight of Melody).

children.text: (पुरबी)
children.translated_text: (<s>Pūrabī</s>)

children.text: बृन्दाबन के बासी कन्हैया लागोमोरी गोहारहो ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Kanhaiyā</s>, dweller of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, hear my cry! ||

children.text: टेक ।। घटघट के तुम हौ प्रभु बासी
children.translated_text: Refrain. || You are the Lord dwelling in every heart,

children.text: सचराचर नरनारिहो ।। गुण औगुण कछु
children.translated_text: in all moving and unmoving beings, men and women. || Neither virtue nor fault

children.text: तुमसों छिपो नहिं सुन्दर नन्दकुमारहो
children.translated_text: is hidden from you, O beautiful <s>Nandakumāra</s> (son of Nanda)!

children.text: ।। १ ।। बृन्दाबनके० ।। भगत हेत नाना
children.translated_text: || 1 || O dweller of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>... || For the sake of devotees you assume many

children.text: तनु धारत संकट सहत अपारहो ।। सब
children.translated_text: forms and endure immeasurable hardships. || In every way you remove

children.text: बिधि शोक हरत पुहुमीकर संतन प्राण
children.translated_text: sorrow from the earth, you are the very life-support

children.text: अधारहो ।। २ ।। बृन्दाबनके०।। यह
children.translated_text: of the saints. || 2 || O dweller of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>... || This

children.text: संसार सकल मतलबको कोई नहीं हित-
children.translated_text: entire world is driven by self-interest; no one is a true

children.text: कारहो ।। भाई बन्धु कुटुम परिवारा स्वारथ
children.translated_text: well-wisher. || Brothers, kin, family, and relatives — all dealings are

children.text: को ब्योहारहो ।। ३ ।। बृन्दाबनके० ।। मैं
children.translated_text: for selfish gain. || 3 || O dweller of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>... || I am

children.text: अज्ञान भजन नहिं जानौं कस उतरौं
children.translated_text: ignorant and know not devotion; how shall I cross

children.text: मवपारहो ।। प्यारेके ईश सब बिधि
children.translated_text: this ocean of existence? || <s>Pyāre</s>'s Lord, O <s>Keśava</s>, in every way

children.text: केशौ गहिकर पार उतारहो ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: take my hand and ferry me across! || 4 ||

children.text: बृन्दाबन के बासी कन्हैया लागो मोरी
children.translated_text: O <s>Kanhaiyā</s>, dweller of <s>Vṛndāvana</s>, hear

children.text: गोहारहो ।।
children.translated_text: my cry! ||

children.text: दो० बासी बृन्दाबिपिनके, गोपिनके चितचोर ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Dweller of the <s>Vṛndāvana</s> groves, stealer of the <s>gopīs</s>' hearts,

children.text: मम गोहार लागो प्रभू, नागर नन्द किशोर ।।
children.translated_text: hear my cry, O Lord — clever young <s>Nandakiśora</s> (son of Nanda). ||

children.text: (पुरबी)
children.translated_text: (<s>Pūrabī</s>)

children.text: हेराधाबरमोरीलागोगुहरियादु पदीकरतपुकारहो।।
children.translated_text: O Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>, hear my plea! <s>Draupadī</s> cries out to you! ||

children.text: शकुनी करण बुद्धिचछु नृप सब
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuni</s> devised the plan with his cunning; all the kings

children.text: दुश्शासन अघधारहो ।। हुकम कस्यो
children.translated_text: and <s>Duśśāsana</s> bore the burden of sin. || The order was given by

children.text: दुर्योधन राजा द्रुपदी लाउ सभाके मँझार
children.translated_text: King <s>Duryodhana</s>: 'Bring <s>Draupadī</s> into the midst of the assembly!'

children.text: हो ।। १ ।। हे राधा०।। पाय हुकम दुश्शासन
children.translated_text: || 1 || O Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>... || Receiving the order, <s>Duśśāsana</s>

children.text: चलिभे लावन हेत तयारहो ।। गहि कर
children.translated_text: set off to fetch her. || Seizing her

children.text: केश सभामधि लायो नृप कहेउकरो उधार
children.translated_text: by the hair, he dragged her into the assembly; the king said, 'Strip her!'

children.text: हो ।। २ ।। हे राधा० ।। खैंचत चीर दुश्शासन
children.translated_text: || 2 || O Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>... || <s>Duśśāsana</s> pulled at her garment

children.text: रिस करि कांपत सब संसारहो ।। नांगे
children.translated_text: in fury, and the whole world trembled. || On bare

children.text: पांयन दौरे रमापति बाढ़ी बसन की
children.translated_text: feet <s>Ramāpati</s> (Kṛṣṇa) rushed forth, and the stream of cloth

children.text: धारहो ।। ३ ।। हे राधा० ।। दससहस्र
children.translated_text: kept growing. || 3 || O Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>... || With the strength of ten thousand

children.text: बारण बल थकि गयो अम्बर भयो न
children.translated_text: elephants he grew weary, yet the garment could not

children.text: उधारहो ।। राखेउ लाज जानि निज
children.translated_text: be undone. || He preserved the honor of one he knew as his own

children.text: दासी प्यारे है दास तुम्हारहो ।। ४ ।। हे
children.translated_text: servant — <s>Pyāre</s> says, I too am your servant. || 4 || O

children.text: राधाबर मोरी लागो गहरिया द्रुपदी करत
children.translated_text: Lord of <s>Rādhā</s>, hear my plea! <s>Draupadī</s> cries

children.text: पुकार हो ।।
children.translated_text: out! ||

children.text: दो० जिमि द्रुदीकी लाज हित, बढ़ी बसनकी धार ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Just as for <s>Draupadī</s>'s honor the stream of cloth kept growing,

children.text: तिमि प्यारे पर कृप करि, करो हृदय पैसार ।।
children.translated_text: so too, <s>Pyāre</s> prays, shower your grace upon me and enter my heart. ||

children.text: (बिहाग)
children.translated_text: (<s>Rāga Bihāg</s>)

children.text: बिहारी मोहिंका भूलो न एक धरी ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Bihārī</s> (Kṛṣṇa), do not forget me even for a moment! ||

children.text: अंतरा ।। तौ पदमें मनमोर मधुपयों निशि
children.translated_text: Interlude. || In your feet my mind is like a bee, day and

children.text: दिन नामररी ।। १ ।। बिहारी मोहिंका० ।।
children.translated_text: night absorbed in your name. || 1 || O <s>Bihārī</s>, do not forget me... ||

children.text: अन्तरा ।। मोर मुकुट पीताम्बर ओढ़े मु-
children.translated_text: Interlude. || Wearing the peacock crown and yellow garment, the

children.text: रली अधर धरी ।। २ ।। बिहारी मोहिंका० ।।
children.translated_text: flute held to your lips. || 2 || O <s>Bihārī</s>, do not forget me... ||

children.text: अन्तरा ।। जब पदपङ्कज मम हृदि धरि
children.translated_text: Interlude. || When you place your lotus feet in my heart,

children.text: हौ तब सब शोक हरी ।। ३ ।। बिहारी
children.translated_text: then all sorrow is removed. || 3 || O <s>Bihārī</s>,

children.text: मोहिंका० ।। प्यारे को आश सांवरो
children.translated_text: do not forget me... || <s>Pyāre</s>'s hope is in the dark-complexioned Lord

children.text: जीकी मोहिं सनाथ करी ।। ४ ।। बिहारी
children.translated_text: who has made me blessed. || 4 || O <s>Bihārī</s>,

children.text: मोहिंका भूलो न एक घरी ।।
children.translated_text: do not forget me even for a moment! ||

children.text: दो० भूलो एक धरी नहीं, सुन्दर श्याम सुजान ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Do not forget me for a single moment, O beautiful, dark, wise Lord!

children.text: बास करो मो हृदय में, आपन किङ्कर जान ।।
children.translated_text: Come dwell in my heart, knowing me as your own servant. ||

children.text: (बिहाग)
children.translated_text: (<s>Rāga Bihāg</s>)

children.text: राम तम कब बसिहौ उर आय ।।
children.translated_text: O <s>Rāma</s>, when will you come and dwell in my heart? ||

children.text: जैसे बसेउ हरि ध्रुवके उरमें दरशन
children.translated_text: Just as <s>Hari</s> (Viṣṇu) dwelt in the heart of <s>Dhruva</s> and granted him

children.text: दीन्ह्येु जाया ।। १ ।। रामतुम० ।। जैसे बसेउ
children.translated_text: his divine vision, || 1 || O <s>Rāma</s>... || just as he dwelt

children.text: द्रुपदीके उरमें दीन्हेउ बसन बढ़ाया ।। २ ।।
children.translated_text: in the heart of <s>Draupadī</s> and made her garment grow endlessly, || 2 ||

children.text: राम तुम ० ।। जैसे बसेउ राजा बलिके
children.translated_text: O <s>Rāma</s>... || just as he dwelt in the heart of King <s>Bali</s>,

children.text: उर दरशदेत नित धाय ।। ३ ।। राम तुम ० ।।
children.translated_text: ever rushing to grant him his vision, || 3 || O <s>Rāma</s>... ||

children.text: प्यारे कहै वैसे अर्ज़ी मम सुनि उरमें रहौ
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says, in like manner hear my petition too, and abide

children.text: समाय ।। ४ ।। राम तुम कब बासहौ उर
children.translated_text: within my heart. || 4 || O <s>Rāma</s>, when will you come and dwell in my

children.text: आय ।।
children.translated_text: heart? ||

children.text: दो० जिमि हरि धना भक्वको, तुम लीन्हेउ अपनाय ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Just as <s>Hari</s> accepted the devotee <s>Dhanā</s> as his own,

children.text: बिना बीज जामी कृषी, दीन्हेउ प्रकट देखाय ।।
children.translated_text: a harvest sprouted without seed — he revealed it openly. ||

children.text: (राग खम्माच)
children.translated_text: (<s>Rāga Khammāc</s>)

children.text: अब तो कोइ नहीं है सेवा नन्दवारे ।।
children.translated_text: Now there is no one, O son of <s>Nanda</s>, who serves you as I do. ||

children.text: कैसो भूलो अजान हृदय नाहींन
children.translated_text: How foolish and ignorant I have been! The heart has no

children.text: ज्ञान ध्यायो क्यों नहिं सुजान रैन दिन
children.translated_text: wisdom. Why did I not meditate upon you, O wise Lord, day and night

children.text: बिसारे ।। १ ।। अब तो० ।। झूठे जग
children.translated_text: I forgot you! || 1 || Now there is no one... || In this false world

children.text: माहिं आय दीन्हेउ सगरो गँवाय गायो
children.translated_text: I came and squandered everything; I never sang the praises of

children.text: नहिं रामराय जाके लोक सारे ।। २ ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Rāmarāya</s> (Lord Rāma) who is the essence of all worlds. || 2 ||

children.text: अवतो० ।।लोभेउ सुतबित्त नारि दीन्हेउ
children.translated_text: Now there is no one... || Greedy for son, wealth, and wife, I

children.text: प्रभको बिसारि अन्त समय सकल छाड़ि
children.translated_text: forgot the Lord; at the end, abandoning all,
one is cast into the noose of Death. || 3 || Now there is no one... || Therefore

children.text: मन करो चेत हरिहरसों लाव हेत राम
children.translated_text: awaken your mind, attach it to <s>Hari</s> with love, make the name of <s>Rāma</s>

children.text: नाम करो खेत बनिहै सब प्यारे ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: your field — all will turn out well, says <s>Pyāre</s>. || 4 ||

children.text: अब तो कोइ नहीं है सेवा नन्दवारे ।।
children.translated_text: Now there is no one, O son of <s>Nanda</s>, who serves you as I do. ||

children.text: दो० तबतौ यह जानेउ नहीं, है यह जग दुकहसार
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: Even then I did not understand that this world is an ocean of sorrow;

children.text: अब पावत दुख बहां बहु, बिन हित नन्दकुमार ।।
children.translated_text: now I suffer many sorrows without you, O <s>Nandakumāra</s> (son of Nanda). ||

children.text: (कजरी)
children.translated_text: (<s>Kajarī</s>)

children.text: देखोशोभायाअवधकी सुन्दरसरजूजीके तीरा ।।
children.translated_text: Behold the splendor of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, on the beautiful banks of the <s>Sarayū</s>! ||

children.text: धन्य अवध जहँके नृप दशरथ जिन
children.translated_text: Blessed is <s>Ayodhyā</s>, where King <s>Daśaratha</s> ruled, whose

children.text: के सुत रघुबीर ।। १ ।। देखो ० ।। जहँपर
children.translated_text: son was <s>Raghubīra</s> (Rāma). || 1 || Behold the splendor... || Where

children.text: साध सन्त बहुतेरे पौरि हनुमति रनधीर
children.translated_text: many sages and saints dwell, and <s>Hanumān</s> the brave warrior

children.text: ।। २ ।। देखो ० ।। आये देश देश नरनारी
children.translated_text: stands guard. || 2 || Behold the splendor... || People from every land have come,

children.text: मै झूला अति भीर ।। ३ ।। देखो ० ।। प्यारे
children.translated_text: men and women, and at the festival the crowd is immense. || 3 || Behold the splendor... || <s>Pyāre</s> says,

children.text: पाप लेश नहिं राखत सरजूजीको नीर
children.translated_text: not a trace of sin remains — the waters of the <s>Sarayū</s>

children.text: ।। ४ ।। देखो शोभा या अवध की सुन्दर
children.translated_text: wash it all away. || 4 || Behold the splendor of <s>Ayodhyā</s>, on the beautiful

children.text: सरजूजी के तीर ।।
children.translated_text: banks of the <s>Sarayū</s>. ||

children.text: दो० मांगों दोउ करजोरिके, सुनिये श्रीरघुबीर ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: With folded hands I beg, hear me O <s>Śrī Raghubīra</s>,

children.text: दरश देहु मोहिं अवधकर, अरु सर जूका नीर ।।
children.translated_text: grant me the sight of <s>Ayodhyā</s> and the waters of the <s>Sarayū</s>. ||

children.text: (लावनी)
children.translated_text: (<s>Lāvanī</s>)

children.text: तुम्हरे सम दीननकेर न कोइ हित-
children.translated_text: There is no well-wisher of the wretched like you,

children.text: कारी । दासनहित दीनानाथ सहो दुख
children.translated_text: O Lord of the destitute, you endure heavy suffering for your servants.

children.text: भारी ।। अन्तरा ।। जब द्रुपदी कीन पु-
children.translated_text: || Interlude. || When <s>Draupadī</s> cried out,

children.text: कार सुनो यटुराई । खैंचत दुश्शासन चीर
children.translated_text: hear her plea! <s>Duśśāsana</s> was pulling her garment,

children.text: दया नहिं आई ।। तब नांगे पांवन त्याग
children.translated_text: yet no compassion arose. || Then on bare feet, leaving

children.text: द्वारिका धाई । द्रपदीके अंग प्रबेश ब-
children.translated_text: <s>Dvārikā</s>, he rushed forth; upon <s>Draupadī</s>'s body the cloth

children.text: सन सरसाई ।। तब देवन जै जै कार सु-
children.translated_text: kept flowing. || Then the gods showered cries of 'Victory! Victory!' and rained

children.text: मन बहु डारी ।। १ ।। तुम्हरे सम ० ।। जब
children.translated_text: many flowers. || 1 || There is no one like you... || When

children.text: भो रावण खल बृन्द उपद्रव कीना । सब
children.translated_text: the wicked <s>Rāvaṇa</s> and his hordes wrought havoc, and all

children.text: होम यज्ञ मख भाग अमिट करिदीना ।।
children.translated_text: the fire-offerings, sacrifices, and rituals were rendered fruitless,

children.text: तब पृथिवी युत सबदेव बिनै बहु कीना ।
children.translated_text: then <s>Pṛthivī</s> (Earth) together with all the gods made many supplications.

children.text: राम भई बिमल नभ बानि निडर करि
children.translated_text: A clear voice resounded from the sky, '<s>Rāma</s> will come,' making them fearless.

children.text: दीना ।। मानुष को बपु प्रभु धारि रावणा
children.translated_text: || The Lord assumed a human form and slew

children.text: मारी ।। २ ।। तुमरे सम ० ।। जब ग्राह ग्र-
children.translated_text: <s>Rāvaṇa</s>. || 2 || There is no one like you... || When the crocodile

children.text: सेउ गज काहिं युद्ध भई भारी । बहु कालन
children.translated_text: seized the elephant, a great battle ensued; for a very long

children.text: लौं भई युद्ध न कोऊ हारी ।। तब थकित सु
children.translated_text: time the fight went on, neither could prevail. || Then the elephant-king grew exhausted,

children.text: भयो गजराज दीन ह्वै पुकारी । चढ़ि बा-
children.translated_text: and in his distress he cried out. || Mounting

children.text: हन गरुड़ गोपाल ग्राह हनि डारी ।। सुनि
children.translated_text: his vehicle <s>Garuḍa</s>, <s>Gopāla</s> (Kṛṣṇa/Viṣṇu) struck down the crocodile. || Hearing

children.text: आरत बचन कृपाल गयन्द उबारी ।। ३ ।।
children.translated_text: the distressed cry, the compassionate Lord rescued <s>Gajendra</s> (the elephant). || 3 ||

children.text: तुम्हरे सम ० ।। रघुनाथदास को नाथ
children.translated_text: There is no one like you... || <s>Raghunātha</s> (Rāma), you are the Lord of the helpless,

children.text: दीन तुम पहरा । सब त्याग बिषै संसार
children.translated_text: protector of the destitute. || Renouncing all worldly attachments,

children.text: तुम्ही मन ठहरा ।। मम उरमें याही आश
children.translated_text: my mind rests in you alone. || In my heart this is my only hope —

children.text: ज्ञान करु गहरा । पदपंकज मम हृद
children.translated_text: deepen my knowledge. || May your lotus feet

children.text: बसैं प्रेमकर लहरा ।। प्यारे मांगत है यही
children.translated_text: dwell in my heart with waves of love. || <s>Pyāre</s> begs for this alone —

children.text: भक्त बनवारी ।। ४ ।। तम्हरे सम दीनन
children.translated_text: make me your devotee, O <s>Banvārī</s> (Kṛṣṇa). || 4 || There is no one

children.text: केर न कोइ हितकारी ।।
children.translated_text: like you, no well-wisher of the wretched. ||

children.text: दो० है तुम्हरे सम दास को, हितू नहीं कोउ नाथ ।
children.translated_text: <s>Dohā</s>: There is no friend for your servant like you, O Lord;

children.text: गिरि कानन सरिता भवन, छांड़तहौ नहिं साथ ।।
children.translated_text: through mountains, forests, rivers, and homes, you never leave my side. ||

children.text: (अद्धा)
children.translated_text: (<s>Addhā</s>)

children.text: नज़रियाहो रघुबरसे लगाओ ।।
children.translated_text: Fix your gaze upon <s>Raghubara</s> (Rāma, best of Raghu's line)! ||

children.text: भोजन बिमल धरो थारा में भुजनुवा
children.translated_text: Place pure food on a shining plate,

children.text: हो रघुबरको जेंवाओ ।। १ ।। नज़रिया ०।।
children.translated_text: and serve it to <s>Raghubara</s> (Lord Rāma). ||1|| <s>Nazariyā</s> (refrain) ||

children.text: पांच पान को बीरा लगाओ सो बीराहो
children.translated_text: Prepare a betel-leaf fold of five pān leaves, that betel fold—

children.text: रघुबरको खिलाओ ।। २ ।। नज़रिया ० ।।
children.translated_text: offer it to <s>Raghubara</s> to enjoy. ||2|| <s>Nazariyā</s> (refrain) ||

children.text: सेज सजाओ फूल चन्दन धरि सेजरिया
children.translated_text: Adorn the bed, placing flowers and sandalwood upon the couch—

children.text: हो रघुबरको सुलाओ ।। ३ ।। नज़रिया ०।।
children.translated_text: and lay <s>Raghubara</s> to rest. ||3|| <s>Nazariyā</s> (refrain) ||

children.text: प्यारे धनयुत भवन अर्प हरि औ देहिया
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says: offer your wealthy home and body to <s>Hari</s>—

children.text: हो रघुबर में लगाओ ।। ४ ।। नज़-
children.translated_text: devote yourself to <s>Raghubara</s>. ||4|| <s>Naz</s>-

children.text: रियाहो रघुबर से लगाओ ।।
children.translated_text: <s>ariyā</s> (refrain)—devote yourself to <s>Raghubara</s>. ||

children.text: दो० नृत्य करो प्रभु सामने, गाओ हरिके गीत।
children.translated_text: Couplet: Dance before the Lord, sing songs of <s>Hari</s>,

children.text: मगन होहु यहि भावमें करिकै सांवी प्रीत ।।
children.translated_text: become absorbed in this mood, cultivating true love. ||

children.text: (ग़ज़ल)
children.translated_text: (Ghazal)

children.text: सुनो नादान मन मेरे बृथा इत उत
children.translated_text: Listen, O my foolish mind, you wander aimlessly here and

children.text: फिरै भटका । फिरै चाहै कोह दश्तों में
children.translated_text: there, astray. You may roam in mountains and deserts—

children.text: करै मत शेरका खटका ।। जपै लैलो नि-
children.translated_text: do not fear the lion. || Chant <s>Lailā</s> (the Beloved) con-

children.text: हार हरदम जिसे अक़बाल मारी है ।
children.translated_text: stantly—the one whose glory is renowned.

children.text: भरोसा सद्क कर उसपर वही नँदलाल
children.translated_text: Place your trust truly in Him—that very <s>Nandlāl</s> (Kṛṣṇa),

children.text: नटखटका ।। १ ।। सुनो नादान मन ० ।।
children.translated_text: the mischievous one. ||1|| Listen, O foolish mind (refrain) ||

children.text: ग़मो रंजो तमा हिरसो यह क़ाबिल तर्क
children.translated_text: Grief, sorrow, greed, and envy—these are worthy of

children.text: कारीहैं । ख़बर लेगा वही मालिक जो
children.translated_text: abandonment. That very Master will take care of you, He who

children.text: बासी है जमुनतटका ।। २ ।। सुनो ना-
children.translated_text: dwells on the bank of the <s>Yamunā</s>. ||2|| Listen, O foo-

children.text: दानमन० ।। नहीं हमदर्दीहै तेरा कोई यह
children.translated_text: lish mind (refrain) || No one is truly your sympathizer in this

children.text: ख़िल्क़ सारीहै । मुहब्बत कर वफ़ा देगा
children.translated_text: entire creation. Love Him and He will grant you faithfulness—

children.text: जो ब्यापक है सभी घटका ।। ३ ।। सुनो
children.translated_text: He who pervades every heart. ||3|| Listen,

children.text: नादानमन० ।। अरे ग़ाफ़िल तुझे सैयाद
children.translated_text: O foolish mind (refrain) || O heedless one, the hunter

children.text: पकरना करता जारीहै । बचावै ख़िलफ़
children.translated_text: continues to pursue you. Against that, the son of

children.text: दशरथ का तुझे प्यारे नहीं खटका ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Daśaratha</s> will save you—<s>Pyāre</s> says, have no worry. ||4||

children.text: सुनो नादान मन मेरे बृथा इत उत फिरै
children.translated_text: Listen, O my foolish mind, you wander aimlessly here and there,

children.text: भटका ।।
children.translated_text: astray. ||

children.text: दो० दुज़्द चार हरदम तेरे, लाहक़ में नादान ।
children.translated_text: Couplet: Four thieves constantly lurk about you, O foolish one.

children.text: राम नाम धनु ज़बांसर, कर इनको कुरबान ।।
children.translated_text: Keep the bow of <s>Rāma</s>'s name on your tongue, and sacrifice them. ||

children.text: (ग़ज़ल)
children.translated_text: (Ghazal)

children.text: श्रीनन्द के फ़र्ज़न्द हमारी तो ख़बर
children.translated_text: O son of Śrī <s>Nanda</s>, take notice of

children.text: ले ।। सधना था ज़बेकार तवायफ़ थी बद
children.translated_text: us. || <s>Sadhnā</s> was a worthless butcher, and <s>Sūnā</s> was a courtesan of ill

children.text: अफ़आल सुवना पढ़ाके वह तरी मेरी
children.translated_text: repute—teaching her, You delivered her; so take notice of

children.text: तो ख़बर ले ।। १ ।। श्रीनन्द ० ।। साअर
children.translated_text: me too. ||1|| Śrī <s>Nanda</s> (refrain) || The sage

children.text: हुये बालमीकिरामायण को जिन गाया ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Vālmīki</s> became purified; he who sang the <s>Rāmāyaṇa</s>—

children.text: बरअक्स नाम जपके हमारी तो ख़बर
children.translated_text: by chanting Your name in reverse, take notice of

children.text: ले ।। २। । श्रीनन्द ० ।। कोई न वस्फ़ मुझमें
children.translated_text: us. ||2|| Śrī <s>Nanda</s> (refrain) || I have no virtue in me,

children.text: न कोई भी हुनर हैं नादान बेवक़ारहों मेरी
children.translated_text: nor any skill—I am a useless fool; take

children.text: तो ख़बर ले ।। ३ ।। श्रीनन्द ०।। कहता
children.translated_text: notice of me. ||3|| Śrī <s>Nanda</s> (refrain) ||

children.text: प्यारे लाल ग़ुलामीमें लगाओ ताऊसके
children.translated_text: <s>Pyārelāl</s> says: engage me in Your service, that I may ride

children.text: सवार हमारी तो ख़बर ले ।। ४ ।। श्री
children.translated_text: Your steed—take notice of us. ||4|| Śrī

children.text: नन्द के फ़र्ज़न्द हमारी तो ख़बर ले ।।
children.translated_text: <s>Nanda</s>'s son, take notice of us. ||

children.text: (ग़ज़ल)
children.translated_text: (Ghazal)

children.text: आयाहूं क़दमबोसीको ख़िदमत में
children.translated_text: I have come to kiss Your feet—employ me in

children.text: लगालो ।। किस्ती मेरी डगमगाती है मल्लाह
children.translated_text: Your service. || My boat is teetering, there is no

children.text: है नहीं । डूबै प्रभू पावै नहीं साहिलप
children.translated_text: boatman. I drown, O Lord, and find no shore—
take me ashore. ||1|| I have come (refrain) || I have

children.text: न दोस्तहै कोई न मुरब्बी । अन्धेरे चाह
children.translated_text: no friend, no patron. I have fallen into a dark

children.text: में पड़ा हम को तो निकालो ।। २ ।।
children.translated_text: well—pull me out. ||2||

children.text: आयाहूं ०।। आना तुम्हारे कूचेका मुश-
children.translated_text: I have come (refrain) || Coming to Your lane is diffi-

children.text: किल है रामजी । मंज़िल करै तै वह जिसे
children.translated_text: cult, O <s>Rāmajī</s>. Only he reaches that destination whom You

children.text: क़दमों में लगस्तो ।। ३ ।। आयाहूं ० ।। कहता
children.translated_text: attach to Your feet. ||3|| I have come (refrain) ||

children.text: प्यारे है मेरे दिल में यही रुग़बत । आक़ा
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says: this is the longing in my heart—You be

children.text: हो हमारे तुम्हीं ख़िदमत में लगालो ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: my Master; employ me in Your service. ||4||

children.text: आयाहुं क़दमबोसी को ख़िदमत में
children.translated_text: I have come to kiss Your feet—employ me in

children.text: लगालो ।।
children.translated_text: Your service. ||

children.text: दो० कोई बचता है नहीं, अजल लिये शमशेर ।
children.translated_text: Couplet: No one escapes—death wields its sword.

children.text: ख़ोरशेद मह कोह जल, ख़िल्क़त धनद कुबेर
children.translated_text: Sun, moon, mountains, water, all creation, even <s>Kubera</s> (god of wealth)—

children.text: (ग़ज़ल)
children.translated_text: (Ghazal)

children.text: जिस तरह मक्खी शहदमें उस तरह
children.translated_text: Just as a fly is trapped in honey, so too are

children.text: से क़ैदहै । हाय गफ़लत हिर्ससे हम बाज़
children.translated_text: we captive. Alas, from heedlessness and greed we do not

children.text: आते हैं नहीं ।। जिस तरह ० ।। होरहे सब
children.translated_text: desist. || Just as (refrain) || Everyone is melting away

children.text: हैं बताशा आबबारिश की तरह । तिसपै
children.translated_text: like sugar drops in rain. Yet

children.text: रानाई से चलना तर्क करतै हैं नहीं ।। १ ।।
children.translated_text: they do not cease walking with pride. ||1||

children.text: जिस तरह ० ।। देखते चश्मोंसे हैं हम
children.translated_text: Just as (refrain) || We see with our own eyes—these

children.text: यह मज़ारैंहैं बनी । क्या बिरादर दोस्तां
children.translated_text: are graves that have been built. Neither brother, nor friend,

children.text: फ़र्ज़न्द भी रहते नहीं ।। १ ।। जिस तरह ० ।।
children.translated_text: nor son remains. ||1|| Just as (refrain) ||

children.text: माल दौलत कर मुहैया मिस्ल क़ारूंकी
children.translated_text: Amassing wealth and riches like <s>Qārūn</s> (Croesus),

children.text: तरह । आख़िरी में तर्क कर कुछ साथ
children.translated_text: in the end, abandoning it all—they take

children.text: लेजाते नहीं ।। ३ ।। जिस तरह ० ।। प्यारे
children.translated_text: nothing with them. ||3|| Just as (refrain) || <s>Pyāre</s> says:

children.text: यां रहना नहीं चलना तुझे राहे अदम ।
children.translated_text: you cannot stay here; you must walk the path of non-existence.

children.text: ख़ाक में मिलना ज़बांसे राम आते हैं
children.translated_text: You will mix with dust—yet <s>Rāma</s>'s name does not come to

children.text: नहीं ।। ४ ।। जिस तरह मक्खी शहद में
children.translated_text: your tongue. ||4|| Just as a fly is trapped in honey,

children.text: उस तरह से क़ैदहै । हाय ग़फ़लत हिर्स
children.translated_text: so too are we captive. Alas, from heedlessness and greed

children.text: से हम बाज़ आते हैं नहीं ।।
children.translated_text: we do not desist. ||

children.text: दो० सीमओज़र ख़िलअत बड़ी, और तुआम खुरशन्द ।
children.translated_text: Couplet: Great are the rewards of gold, silver, and robes—and the food of the sun.

children.text: जितनी ख़िलक़त खुदाकी, सब ख़ाकी पैबन्द ।।
children.translated_text: Yet all of God's creation is but patched with dust. ||

children.text: (ग़ज़ल)
children.translated_text: (Ghazal)

children.text: जो कुछ करनाहो वह करले अब अ-
children.translated_text: Whatever you must do, do it now—the message of

children.text: जल पैग़ाम है ।। ज़िन्दगी भर नेकी तुझ
children.translated_text: death has arrived. || You, the useless one, will never do good

children.text: से नहीं होगी बेवक़ार । आरख़िरस अफ़-
children.translated_text: in your entire life. In the end, nothing remains but

children.text: सोस के बजुज़ नहीं कुछ काम है ।। १ ।।
children.translated_text: sighs of regret. ||1||

children.text: जो कुछ ० ।। शाह ओ गदा ताजिरो
children.translated_text: Whatever (refrain) || King and beggar, merchant and

children.text: दहिक़ांभी तो मरजायेंगे । चलना सबको
children.translated_text: peasant—all shall die. Everyone must depart

children.text: दूर है ऊंचा जहां का बाम है ।। २ ।। जो
children.translated_text: far away; high is the roof of this world. ||2|| What-

children.text: कुछ ० ।। देखता चश्मों से यह ख़िलक़त
children.translated_text: ever (refrain) || I see with my eyes—this creation of

children.text: ख़ुदाई हैं मज़ार । तिसप फंसता मिस्ल
children.translated_text: God consists of graves. Yet one gets stuck like a

children.text: मक्खी शहद बद अंजाम है ।। ३ ।। जो
children.translated_text: fly in honey—ill-fated. ||3|| What-

children.text: कुछ ० ।। जितनी मुहब्बत किया ग़ाफ़िल
children.translated_text: ever (refrain) || However much love the heedless one invested

children.text: अयाल अतफ़ाल में । सोचता इतना
children.translated_text: in family and children,

children.text: नहीं प्यारे खुदा से काम है ।। ४ ।। जो
children.translated_text: <s>Pyāre</s> says, he does not think this much—his business is with God. ||4|| What-

children.text: कुछ करना हो वह कर ले अब अजल
children.translated_text: ever you must do, do it now—the message of death

children.text: पैग़ाम है ।।
children.translated_text: has arrived. ||

children.text: दो० जितनी ख़िल्क़तख़ुदा की, अस्प फ़ील असवार ।
children.translated_text: Couplet: All of God's creation—horse, elephant, rider,

children.text: शाहु गदा दुज़्दो ग़नी, जात ख़ुदा दरबार ।।
children.translated_text: king and beggar, thief and wealthy—all go to God's court. ||

children.text: (लावनी)
children.translated_text: (Lāvanī)

children.text: हम कहते सबसों टेरि सुनो हो भाई ।
children.translated_text: We call out to all, proclaiming: listen, O brothers!

children.text: गाओ हरि हर के चरित न आन उपाई ।।
children.translated_text: Sing the deeds of <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s>; there is no other remedy. ||

children.text: अन्तरा ।। निशि दिवस भ्रमत भ्रमजाल
children.translated_text: Stanza: || Day and night, wandering in the snare of

children.text: मध्य तो भटका । शिर पर घेरे है काल
children.translated_text: illusion, you have gone astray. Death looms over your head,

children.text: नहीं कुछ खटका ।। नहिं जानी कौनी
children.translated_text: yet you have no worry. || You do not know in what gain

children.text: लाभ में है मन अटका । एक दिन आ-
children.translated_text: your mind is stuck. One day, in the

children.text: ख़िर को जावैगा तो पटका ।। तासों गा थे
children.translated_text: end, you shall be dashed down. || Therefore, O mind, sing

children.text: मन राम नाम लौलाई ।। हम कहते ० ।। १
children.translated_text: <s>Rāma</s>'s name with devotion. || We call out (refrain) || 1 ||

children.text: यह ठाट सभी मिटिजाय फेरि पछि-
children.translated_text: All this splendor will be erased; then you will

children.text: तैहै । सब रहै जहां का तहां साथ नहिं
children.translated_text: regret. Everything stays where it is; nothing will go

children.text: जैहै ।। यह करत काहली जौन कहो
children.translated_text: with you. || Why this laziness—what will you gain by

children.text: का पैहै । जब करिहै मालिक स्वाल तौ
children.translated_text: it? When the Master asks you, what will

children.text: काह बतैहै ।। मन में तन को नहिं धरक
children.translated_text: you answer? || With no fear in the body, the mind commits

children.text: करत अन्याई ।। हम कहते ० ।। २ ।। बहु
children.translated_text: injustice. || We call out (refrain) || 2 || With much

children.text: ज्ञान अपार गुमान मोह बहु करता । पशु
children.translated_text: knowledge and boundless pride, you do many things in delusion. Like an

children.text: पंछी की है तरह पेट को भरता ।। यह
children.translated_text: animal or bird, you merely fill your belly. || You do

children.text: जानत है तो नहीं कौन है करता । घिरि
children.translated_text: not know who the true Doer is. Dark

children.text: आई काली घटा नहीं तो डरता ।। पावैगा
children.translated_text: clouds have gathered, yet you are not afraid. || You will never

children.text: कभी न चैन बिना सुखदाई । हम क-
children.translated_text: find peace without the Giver of Happiness. || We ca-

children.text: हते ० ।। ३ ।। यह राज पाट संसार संग नहिं
children.translated_text: ll out (refrain) || 3 || This kingdom, realm, and worldly life will not go

children.text: जावै । और नारि भवन बित बस्त्र काम
children.translated_text: with you. And wife, home, wealth, and garments will be of no

children.text: नहिं आवै ।। क्यों मालिक सों नहिं नेह
children.translated_text: use. || Why do you not love the Master, why do you not

children.text: करै नहिं गावै । अब जाता तेरा वक्त फेरि
children.translated_text: sing? Your time is passing now; later you will

children.text: पछितावै ।। यह कहते प्यारेलाल मनहिं
children.translated_text: regret. || Thus says <s>Pyārelāl</s>, instructing the

children.text: समुझाई । हम कहते सबसों टेर सुनो
children.translated_text: mind. || We call out to all, proclaiming: listen,
O brothers! || 4 ||

children.text: दो० बहुत भांति समुझावऊं, तहूँ न मन पतियाय
children.translated_text: Couplet: In many ways I explain, yet the mind does not believe.

children.text: अब प्रभु मालिकहै तुहीं, ख़बर लीजिये आय ।।
children.translated_text: Now You alone are the Lord and Master—please come and take heed. ||

children.text: (लावनी)
children.translated_text: (Lāvanī)

children.text: हम रहते जमुवां गाउ राजधौरहरा
children.translated_text: We reside in the village of <s>Jamuvāṃ</s>, under the kingdom of <s>Dhaurahara</s>;

children.text: खींची नृप हैं परसिद्ध बिदित संसारा ।।
children.translated_text: the <s>Khīñcī</s> kings are well-known and celebrated in the world. ||

children.text: अन्तरा ।। जमुवां में बिप्रनबृन्द रहत
children.translated_text: Stanza: || In <s>Jamuvāṃ</s>, many communities of Brahmins

children.text: बहुतेरे । और क्षत्रिन के शुभ भवन
children.translated_text: dwell, and of Kṣatriyas there are splendid

children.text: विचित्र घनेरे ।। तिन सब में हैं दो भवन
children.translated_text: and numerous noble houses. || Among them all are two houses

children.text: कायस्थ कुलकेरे । सब कृपा करत बहु
children.translated_text: of the <s>Kāyastha</s> clan. All bestow their grace in many

children.text: भांति पुत्र सम हेरे ।। और कहते प्यारे
children.translated_text: ways, regarding us as their own sons. || And they call <s>Pyāre</s>

children.text: नाम हैं सकल हमारा । हम रहते ० ।। १ ।।
children.translated_text: by name—he is known to all. || We reside (refrain) || 1 ||

children.text: कछु काब्य नहीं है पढ़ी न ज्ञानी अ-
children.translated_text: I have not studied any poetry, nor am I a man of know-

children.text: हहों । सब लोगन मस्तक नाय रामयश
children.translated_text: ledge. || Bowing my head before all people, I speak the glory of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: कह हों ।। ज्ञानी मैं होन न चहों न यश को
children.translated_text: || I do not wish to be a learned man, nor do I seek

children.text: चहहों । सबसों अरज़ी है यही राम पद
children.translated_text: fame. My sole petition to all is: may I grasp the feet of <s>Rāma</s>.

children.text: गहहों ।। सो पूरण करि गौरीश देहु अब
children.translated_text: || Fulfill this prayer, O <s>Gaurīśa</s> (Lord Śiva); grant it

children.text: सारा ।। हम रहते ० ।। २ ।। जमुवांके उत्तर
children.translated_text: in full. || We reside (refrain) || 2 || To the north of

children.text: तरफ़ देबी स्थाना । युत अंश देबिका
children.translated_text: <s>Jamuvāṃ</s> is a shrine of the Goddess.

children.text: मातु कीन है थाना ।। मेला संबतमें होत
children.translated_text: The Divine Mother has established Her abode there. || A fair is held

children.text: दोइ परमाना । एक पुरनमासी बैसाख
children.translated_text: twice a year by tradition—

children.text: कुँवारी जाना ।। देबीकी दाया पूर है सुक्ख
children.translated_text: one on the full moon of <s>Vaiśākha</s>, and the other on <s>Kuṃvārī</s> (Āśvina). || The grace of the Goddess is abundant, and happiness

children.text: अपारा । हम रहते ० ।। ३ ।। जो राग कहे
children.translated_text: is limitless. || We reside (refrain) || 3 || Whatever <s>rāgas</s> I have composed and sung, listen with

children.text: हम गाय सुनो दै काना । कछु शुद्ध अ-
children.translated_text: attentive ears. || Do not judge whether they are correct or in-

children.text: शुद्ध बिचारि न हंसेउ सुजाना ।। मैं सेवक
children.translated_text: correct; do not laugh, O wise one. || I am a servant

children.text: हों हरिजनन न है कछुज्ञाना । सो करि
children.translated_text: of the devotees of <s>Hari</s>; I have no knowledge. || Therefore,

children.text: हैं सज्जन नहीं दास अपमाना ।। हरि हर
children.translated_text: O noble ones, do not dishonor this servant. || May <s>Hari</s> and <s>Hara</s>

children.text: मों हृदय में आय करो पैसारा । हम
children.translated_text: enter my heart and make their abode within. || We

children.text: रहते जमुवां गार्ड राज धौरहरा ।। ४ ।।
children.translated_text: reside in the village of <s>Jamuvāṃ</s>, under the kingdom of <s>Dhaurahara</s>. || 4 ||
Victory, victory, victory to <s>Jagadambā Bhavānī</s>!

children.text: इति श्रीरागबिनोद समाप्तम् ।।
children.translated_text: Thus ends the Śrī <s>Rāgabinoda</s>. ||
